schema.description: The request payload for creating a content snippet. You must provide either `json_blocks` or `body_markdown` for the snippet content — they are mutually exclusive.

ai_chatbot_availability.description: Whether the content snippet should be available for AI Chatbot (Fin). Defaults to false.

ai_copilot_availability.description: Whether the content snippet should be available for AI Copilot. Defaults to false.

ai_sales_agent_availability.description: Whether the content snippet should be available for AI Sales Agent. Defaults to false.

audience_ids.description: The list of audience IDs to target this content snippet to for Fin AI Agent. Pass an empty array or omit the field for no audience targeting. Unknown audience IDs return a `404` error with no partial commit.

body_markdown.description: The content of the snippet in markdown. An alternative to `json_blocks` — you can provide content as markdown instead of structured blocks. Mutually exclusive with `json_blocks`.

json_blocks.description: The content blocks that make up the body of the snippet. Mutually exclusive with `body_markdown`.

example.text: Navigate to Settings > Security > Reset password.

locale.description: The locale of the content snippet. Defaults to `en`.

title.description: The title of the content snippet.
